items.summary: The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the continuation of Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU) for a period of five years upto 31.03.2031. The scheme provides credit guarantee coverage to the Lending Institutions through National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited (NCGTC) against default risk.
items.title: Cabinet approves continuation of Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units

items.summary: The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the continuation of Stand-Up India Scheme for a period of 5 years upto 31.03.2031. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship among Women, Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs) and aims to provide financial assistance to additional 2.5 lakh entrepreneurs in a span of five years. items.title: Cabinet approves Continuation of Stand-Up India Scheme

items.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, today has approved the development of the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum (YYBM) at the North and South Block Complex, New Delhi, at an estimated total project cost of ₹3,230 crore , as appraised by the Public Investment Board (PIB).
items.title: Cabinet approves Development of Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum at North and South Block Complex, New Delhi
